subject: Peregrine Dynamics - GCP private offer onramp: stakeholder timeline & billing gates
messages:
From: Olivia Sanders <olivia.sanders@peregrine-dyn.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@peregrine-dyn.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Aug 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initial ask — GCP private offer + billing questions

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks for the briefing earlier. Procurement has asked for a concise MAP that maps our acceptance gates to invoice milestones — they want to see who signs what and when for internal approvals. Two constraints: our finance ops needs a clear path for invoice creation for private offers in GCP (they can’t process until we land a marketplace invoice number), and security needs confirmation that data residency controls are documented before the pilot start.

Could you share a one-page timeline with: stakeholder signoffs, expected DocuSign milestone, and billing gate that Finance will use? Also, any sample private-offer contracts you have on file would help speed legal review.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Sanders
Head of Vendor Programs | Peregrine Dynamics
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Sanders <olivia.sanders@peregrine-dyn.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Aug 2028 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — GCP private offer + billing questions

Hi Olivia — thanks, understood. Attaching a draft MAP (peregrine_map_v1.xlsx) and a short diagram of the billing path. Quick summary below so your team can circulate:

- Pilot kickoff (week 0): Technical acceptance checklist signed by Peregrine engineering lead + Redwood SE.
- DocuSign milestone (T-2 weeks from pilot start): Standard MPA + Marketplace private-offer acceptance (we’ll populate the invoice reference).
- Billing gate: Finance requires marketplace invoice number before first invoice is generated; we’ll coordinate with GCP marketplace team to reserve the invoice reference during DocuSign signing.

Karthik — can you confirm the steps for reserving the GCP invoice number and the expected timeline? Naomi, I’ve flagged you for billing ops questions.

Next actions: I’ll update the MAP based on your procurement template and send a redlineable PDF of the private-offer terms.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Aug 2028 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — GCP private offer + billing questions

Logan / Marissa — quick note on the marketplace invoice flow (GCP private offers):

- Step 1 (internal prep): Submit request to Redwood Marketplace Ops to provision a private-offer package. This includes SKU mapping, commitment term, and our billing code.
- Step 2 (reservation): Redwood triggers GCP to reserve an invoice reference id — this is the identifier Finance uses downstream. Typical lead time: 3 business days after the private-offer package is complete.
- Step 3 (signing): When DocuSign completes, GCP finalizes the private offer and issues an invoice reference.
- Contingency: If procurement delays the DocuSign beyond the reserved window, we re-request the reference (adds ~2 business days).

I’ll work with Marketplace Ops (cc’d offline) to get the reservation started as soon as Peregrine confirms the key SKU and term.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Sanders <olivia.sanders@peregrine-dyn.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@peregrine-dyn.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Aug 2028 11:29:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initial ask — GCP private offer + billing questions

Thanks — this is helpful. Procurement reviewed the draft MAP and pushed a couple of adjustments:

1) We need a legal milestone for SOC2 evidence to be provided before pilot start (they asked for the SOC2 AICPA attestation and a short data flow diagram).
2) Finance wants the first invoice to be scheduled as a pro-forma charge aligned to the accepted pilot date to avoid subscription lag.

Attached: the procurement checklist we use (procurement@peregrine-dyn.com attached). Can you add a legal deliverable and reflect the pro-forma invoice timing in the MAP v1?

Olivia
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Sanders <olivia.sanders@peregrine-dyn.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + legal checklist attached

Olivia — thanks for the procurement checklist. I’ve updated the MAP spreadsheet (attached) to add:

- Legal deliverable: SOC2 attestation + one-page data flow diagram due at T-3 business days before pilot start.
- Invoice scheduling: we’ll include a pro-forma invoice trigger tied to the DocuSign completion date so Finance can post it on the agreed pilot start.
- Owners: Legal (Naomi) — responsible for SOC2 evidence; Marketplace Ops (Karthik) — invoice reservation; Account (Logan) — stakeholder signoffs and pilot scheduling.

I’ve also attached a redlineable copy of the private-offer terms (gcp_private_offer_terms_20280830.pdf) for your legal team. If the procurement team confirms the SKU list and term length today we can start the reservation flow tomorrow.

Next steps: Olivia to confirm SKU + term; Redwood to start reservation + prepare DocuSign packet.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Ops Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Sanders <olivia.sanders@peregrine-dyn.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

- Can Redwood reserve the GCP invoice reference on 2028-09-06 if we share the final SKU today?
- Will the DocuSign packet be ready for signature by Friday 2028-09-08 so Finance can treat the pro-forma invoice as aligned with the pilot start of 2028-09-19?

If those two checkpoints are yes, we’ll schedule the internal approval meeting and lock the pilot start. We’ve copied Tim Huerta from our cloud integration partner who will validate any marketplace setup questions.

Thanks,
Olivia
